_comment: Release manifest for the native GGML RPC worker binaries. At release time, build ggml-rpc-server.exe (+ GGML DLLs) with scripts/windows/build-llama-cpp.ps1, zip them, upload the zip, then set archive_url and archive_sha256 below. Until archive_sha256 is replaced, the installer will NOT download (it refuses unverifiable binaries) and instead requires bundled binaries at build time.
